First-choice line 17 asserts exactly that: 'However, one can show that $\sum_{i=1}^r(\frac{5n}{2}-3i)-3r+\lfloor\frac{(n-3r)^2}{4}\rfloor\leq\lfloor\frac{n^2}{4}\rfloor$'. Under the source's active assumptions (line 8: r = size of a maximal system of disjoint triangles in an n-vertex graph with $\lfloor n^2/4\rfloor+1$ edges; line 12's hypothetical degree-sum bound $v^{(i)}(\alpha_i)+v^{(i)}(\beta_i)+v^{(i)}(\gamma_i)\leq 5n/2-3i$ already substituted at line 16), line 17 is a bare arithmetic inequality in n and r, asserted for the n and r of the proof, and it is the step that is claimed to give the contradiction at line 18.

Evidence checked as supplied; no witness substituted and no repair attempted.
